name: TG-GithubBot
description: Telegram bot that sends GitHub event notifications and lets you manage repositories, issues and pull requests from Telegram.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of this app, no trailing slash, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of your GitHub OAuth App

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random string used to validate GitHub webhook payloads (openssl rand -hex 20)

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Exactly 64 hex chars or 16/24/32 raw bytes for AES-GCM token encryption (openssl rand -hex 32). Do not use a generated value: other lengths are rejected at runtime.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string, e.g. a MongoDB Atlas SRV URI (not the local mongo from docker-compose)
